en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard depicting a small wooden pier and boathouse on a calm waterfront. Several people stand on the pier near a moored steamboat. A stone quay runs along the shoreline, with a modest wooden building and some trees and rocky terrain in the background. The main title is printed in red at the bottom center, and small red text credits the printer and photographer at the lower corners.
